_meta.note: Maintenance: WV-area averages originally from RepairPal + AAA Your Driving Costs 2024 (+5% for mountain road conditions), inflated 2026-09-23 for repair-cost growth (BLS CPI motor vehicle maintenance & repair +14% over two years): oil, brakes, misc ×1.15; tires ×1.05 (tire CPI ~flat). Insurance: estimated full-coverage annual premium for a 35-45 year old with a clean record in WV, scaled 2026-09-23 against 2026 WV averages (NerdWallet $2,144, Bankrate $2,162, ValuePenguin $2,148, Insurify $1,862): sedans ×1.15, SUVs/minivans ×1.25, pickups and Jeep Wrangler ×1.08. Actual rates vary widely by driver history, coverage level, and ZIP code. tank_gallons: usable tank capacity for refueling-time calculation.

ice_vehicles.capability_note: Assumes SuperCrew 4x4 5.5-ft box, 3.73 axle. Ford 2024 towing guide table (hard to parse) shows ~7,500-8,000 lb for 2.7L SuperCrew 4x4 145in WB. Bed 67.1 in is Ford's 5.5-ft box length at floor (not re-read here). Payload varies by build (door-jamb label).

Assumes Crew Cab short bed 4WD. Chevy chart: 5.3L crew short 4x4 = 9,300 lb at 15,000 GCWR (9,000 at 14,500 GCWR); 11,000 with Max Trailering Pkg (NHT). Short bed 69.9 in at floor (dealer source). Payload not found for this config.
Assumes Crew Cab 5'7" box. Ram chart, Tradesman 4x4 Crew 5'7" HEMI: 8,100-8,170 lb with std 3.21 axle, 11,200-11,270 with 3.92 axle; payload 1,800-1,860. Box length at floor 67.4 in (Ram spec sheet).

Assumes Crew Cab short box 4WD. GMC 2024 brochure table is garbled in extraction; ~9,200 lb standard (3.23 axle), ~11,200 with Max Trailering Package. Short box 69.9 in (same box as Silverado). Payload roughly 1,900-2,100 lb by build; not pinned down.

Double Cab 5-ft bed (inside length 60.3 in). Toyota brochure: Double Cab TRD Off-Road max towing 6,400 lb (dealer sites often say 6,500, which is the XtraCab figure). Payload ~1,600 lb but brochure table too garbled to read reliably.

Assumes Crew Cab 4x4 6.75-ft box. XLT seats 6 with front 40/20/40 bench (5 with buckets). 18,200 lb conventional requires optional 4.30 axle; ~16,500 with 3.73 axle. Bed 81.9 in at floor from Ford spec (not re-read here). Payload varies ~3,000-3,700 lb by GVWR package.
4-door. Jeep spec sheet: 31.7 cu ft rear seat up, 72.4 folded. Sport 3.6L max trailer 3,500 lb.
Toyota brochure: 47.2 behind 2nd row / 89.7 behind 1st (46.3/88.8 with sliding cargo deck). TRD Off-Road is 5-seat only.
SXT has 2/3/2 seating (third-row bench). 6,200 lb (V6 AWD) requires the optional towing package.
Two-row Grand Cherokee (not L). Spec sheet: 6,200 lb max trailer for 3.6L 4WD when properly equipped (tow package/hitch). Payload 1,240 lb Laredo 4WD.

Towing verified in Ford guide: 5,300 lb requires Class IV Trailer Tow Pkg (52T); 3,000 lb otherwise (dealer-accessory hitch). Cargo figures from dealer spec summary, not a Ford page. XLT 7 seats with 2nd-row bench.

Towing verified in Chevy 2024 trailering guide: 5.3L 4WD 7,700 lb; 8,200 with Max Trailering Pkg. Cargo (25.5/72.6/122.9) from secondary sources quoting GM spec. LT seats 8 with 2nd-row bench (7 with captain's chairs).

Honda figures include floor space between rows (SAE J1100 plus). Standard seat positions given; with seats forward / 2nd-row middle seat removed: 21.8 / 59.5 / 111.8. AWD 5,000 lb requires accessory towing equipment.
